hypothesis: Can a persistent sensor-prediction-error change detector with adaptive reference, hysteresis and cooldown allocate new continuous banks only for sustained regime changes, avoiding S22's immediate false double-allocation, and outperform both naive one-shot S22 novelty allocation and capacity-matched random routing on fresh hidden-state switched worlds without explicit task labels?

unconventional.name: Persistent Predictive Error Change-Point Memory (PPEC)
unconventional.algorithm: Each training batch calculates the best bank's prefix-24/suffix-8 numerical prediction error, with no task ID. Maintain a context-only causal exponentially updated reference error. A score is anomalous if it exceeds BOTH source-only calibration quantile AND 1.35× reference; do NOT update reference on anomalies. Create a new copied bank only after ≥5 anomalous batches in the last 6, if no refractory cooldown (36 batches) and bank count<3. On allocation, reset anomaly buffer and start 36-batch adaptation cooldown, updating reference from current observed error during cooldown. Outside anomalies, update reference with EWMA 0.10. Never reset detector on stage/family boundaries; phase labels only drive physical world generator and privileged oracle control.
unconventional.features: Identical original S18 raw real-valued 2→32→12 tanh feature map with per-episode ridge, no analytic physics formula given to the predictor.
unconventional.novelty_calibration: Once after phase A, use 16 never-trained-on source-training-range calibration batches, seeds [3331,3343,3359,3371,3389,3407,3413,3433,3449,3461,3467,3491,3511,3527,3533,3541], 48 worlds each; threshold is 90th percentile of mean validation prediction error. Fixed before phases B/C/D; no heldout seed or post-result adjustment.
unconventional.historical_bias: Surprise-triggered memory, hysteretic change-point detectors, EWMA and cooldown have considerable prior art; do not claim a new first-in-world algorithm.
unconventional.allocation_policy: only if calibrated novelty condition and capacity, no allocation based on phase identity
unconventional.copied_bank_on_allocation: copy currently minimum-error bank, create fresh AdamW optimizer
unconventional.random_capacity_control: three banks cloned from source after A; select update bank by deterministic pseudo-random seed+step, select evaluation bank with deterministic hash of observed numeric context; never uses family/task labels.
unconventional.oracle_privileged_comparator: three bank models, train and evaluate source/sine/rational bank by explicit family label. Upper bound only and NOT counted as proof of autonomous routing.
unconventional.routing_accuracy_audit: Compute optimal one-to-one 3-family-to-3-bank assignment of recorded heldout routing counts after C, using family ID ONLY for independent evaluation. Never expose mapping to router. Report per-seed permutation-optimized accuracy.

detection.reference_initialization: mean of frozen source-only calibration batch mean errors

unconventional.naive_S22_baseline: Run original S22 one-step novelty-allocation on same new training worlds, source-only threshold; a separate three-bank model with identical source checkpoint and optimizer states, no old data. Include as direct matched-capacity and training-work negative control. Original S22 results remain untouched.
unconventional.stationary_false_alarm_control: 48 separate source-training-range batch contexts after phase A, with the prefit source bank FROZEN and independent router state; test whether persistent change rule allocates under stationary inputs. It may not see any phase/task labels, old episodes or heldout worlds.

environment.generator: reuse exactly pinned S20 source world. 2 latent physical state variables, only 1D noisy sensor, 3 changed nonlinear families with unknown coefficients and transition-20 switches.

arms.self_organizing: up to 3 banks, error-driven novelty allocation + per-world context-error routing without task labels, no replay
arms.shared_no_replay: single feature model ordinary fine-tuning on exactly same new-only worlds and optimizer counts
arms.random_three_bank: three feature banks after A, random training update and observed-context-hash evaluation; same 3-bank capacity cap, no old data
arms.rehearsal: single feature model with 25% old training-world episodes per batch in B/C/D, explicit extra old-task information disclosure
arms.oracle_label_routed: three feature banks, privileged task-label assignment for training and evaluation, only reference upper bound
arms.GRU: trained 32-unit raw continuous recurrence, same new-only worlds and AdamW steps but different parameter and FLOP budgets
arms.KRR: Gaussian RBF kernel ridge calibrated source-only once, no learned weights
arms.exact_oracle: hidden physical evaluator only, not prediction model
arms.naive_surprise_three_bank: Original S22 threshold-on-single-batch training allocation, 3-bank capacity control, same source initialization and train stream as PPEC.

status.limitations: Only low-dimensional synthetic numerical sensor worlds. No continuous-time unsampled hardware, language understanding, long-term memory generality, RSI, task-free lifelong cognition or independently qualified science; bank memory 3x shared parameter capacity, full contextual routing cost un-matched.

stop_on: exact source drift or dirty worktree
non-finite loss, route score, bank coefficients
bank router accidentally consumes family labels
